coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: P24

notes.accuracy_caveat: APPROXIMATE -- real landscaped open land (lawn, curved path, scattered trees) per Esri satellite imagery and the street/already-tracked-polygon-bounded gap computation, cut at an owner-directed cross-sectional fork point rather than a surveyed parcel boundary. Name and operator not confirmed by any source found in this pass; visually resembles Bayfront Park's own style and may be a continuation of it.
notes.digitized_from: Real-gap-fragment technique: bbox.difference(street buffer).difference(already-tracked polygons) around the 499 Illinois St / Bayfront Park area (fragment 2, 19,181.78 sqm raw). The owner reviewed a 3-way width-scan split of that fragment (at its two real cross-sectional waists, lat 37.7658 and 37.76665) and then directed the same fork-cut technique used for P26: keep the wide single-segment 'head', drop the thin multi-segment 'horns'.

record.notes: OCII plan open-space parcel P24. Triangular waterfront lawn south of 499 Illinois St, along Terry Francois Blvd, adjoining the Bayfront Park path.
